description: This file implements a token stream rewriter for the ANTLR parser generator, allowing lazy modifications (insert, replace, delete) on token streams with support for multiple named rewrite programs and complex operation reduction logic.

classes.name: TokenStreamRewriter
classes.description: Main class managing token stream modifications with multiple rewrite programs.

classes.name: RewriteOperation
classes.description: Interface defining a rewrite operation with execution and metadata methods.

classes.name: BaseRewriteOperation
classes.description: Base class implementing common functionality for rewrite operations.

classes.name: InsertBeforeOp
classes.description: Represents an insertion operation before a token.

classes.name: InsertAfterOp
classes.description: Represents an insertion operation after a token.

classes.name: ReplaceOp
classes.description: Represents a replacement operation over a token range.

methods.name: GetTokenStream
methods.description: Returns the original token stream being modified.

methods.name: Rollback
methods.description: Reverts instructions for a program to a previous instruction index.

methods.name: InsertAfter
methods.description: Adds an insert-after operation to a program.

methods.name: InsertBefore
methods.description: Adds an insert-before operation to a program.

methods.name: Replace
methods.description: Adds a replace operation over a token range.

methods.name: GetText
methods.description: Generates the modified text from tokens based on queued operations.
